Package service

package service
Provides all service-layer components of the Library Management System.

This package contains interfaces and classes responsible for:

  • Admin operations
  • Book management
  • User management
  • Email notifications
  • Overdue reporting

It acts as the core business logic layer between the presentation and the library domain model.

  • Class
    Description
    AdminService
    Defines all administrator-level operations supported by the library system.
    AdminServiceImpl
    In-memory implementation of AdminService.
    BookService
    Service interface defining all book-related operations in the library system.
    BookServiceImpl
    In-memory implementation of the BookService interface.
    EmailService
    Provides functionality for sending emails using Gmail's SMTP server.
    OverdueReportService
    Provides calculation logic for overdue fines across mixed media types (Books and CDs) as part of Sprint 5.
